हेष्, i. 1, Ātm. To neigh as a horse, Pañc. iv. d. 49.
 हेषित, m. Neighing, Episod. MBh. de Śakuntala, ed. Chezy., 1, 16.
 --Cf. probably Lat. hinnire, hinnulus; γίννος; but cf. also ह्रेष्.
हेष् + आ, f. Neighing (as a horse, or braying, as an ass),
हेषाय, a denomin. derived from हेषा with य, Ātm. To neigh, Pañc. 254, 25.
